from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyROEMetric(BaseModel):
    """One company's weighted average return on equity from a financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The metric name as written in the document")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value for this metric, as a percentage")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this metric covers")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="The section where this data was found, as written in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_roe_metrics: list[CompanyROEMetric]
